highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with raster, text and GPU rendering corrections.
highlights_body: The preview line also makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Release Candidate 1 adds reflected-hairline and text-atlas fixes and a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss workaround.

breaking.title: Check the native Graphite Metal runtime minimum
breaking.body: Native Graphite Metal now requires iOS/tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. If you use that backend directly, update deployment targets accordingly. These are native-backend minima, not replacements for any higher managed-package or framework requirements.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m157 while preserving the existing managed API surface and the glyph-bounds guard carried from m156.

Fixes coverage-mask clamping, convex-path device bounds and a heap overflow in convex anti-aliased paths across vertical clip gaps. Adds direct-mask Slug validation and corrects unsupported fractional glyph replay.
Corrects Graphite clip-key packing, wedge inflation and A-to-RGBx GPU-to-CPU transfer stride, and initializes Vulkan render-pass pointers correctly.

Keeps zero-length square-capped hairlines correctly sized under reflected transforms and rounds Ganesh text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong atlas. Adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56.

LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport paths across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, SceneGraph, Skottie and Resources. This addresses an ABI mismatch that can affect Windows x86; runtime confirmation of the reported stack-growth symptom remains outstanding.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and Ganesh text-atlas selection. It also adds a targeted Mali Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround.
preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections, plus explicit cdecl LibraryImport metadata. Native Graphite Metal now requires iOS/tvOS 15; higher managed-package requirements still apply.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport convention. This corrects a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch without changing the public managed API.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl. Native Graphite Metal requires iOS/tvOS 15, with any higher managed-package requirements still applying. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing the native HarfBuzz version.

v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas selection in Skia m157.
v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6.body: It also adds a targeted device-loss cleanup workaround for affected Mali Vulkan drivers. The managed API surface is unchanged.
